authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states for the three live G18 v2 namedCorpusNotAuthored classes, drawn from G18 v2 namedCorpusClasses exactByteIntent. v2 lands CLAUDE-G18LJ-V2-SF1 / the empty-state defect of g18-input-corpus.v1. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a journal. It does not invent a journal format, lock-file grammar, lease API, solver, or filesystem layout. It does not import DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW. It does not SATISFY DR-107. It does not execute G18. It does not close leftover-design of G18 fixture implementations. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
